text: Ship and ocean engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as engineering mechanics, mechanical design, materials science, fluid mechanics, and control engineering. It mainly focuses on the design, construction, operation and maintenance of ships and marine structures (such as drilling platforms and submarine pipelines), as well as technical research and application in areas like marine resource development and marine environment utilization. This discipline not only covers "waterborne" ship engineering but also encompasses "underwater" marine engineering. It is one of the core disciplines that support the marine economy, national security, and global trade.
